deskQrHiddenReply: Show it to the sender’s wallet. Only their wallet can use it.

@deskQrHiddenReply.description: Under the covered reply QR on desktop: the receiver's reply to a payment (QR Payment), shown back to the sender's wallet, on a phone or another computer.

deskQrHiddenPaid: Show it to the wallet that asked for the payment. Only that wallet can use it.

@deskQrHiddenPaid.description: Under the covered QR of an answer to an invoice on desktop, shown back to whoever asked for the payment.

deskQrTimedOutBody: Show it again when the other device is ready.

@deskQrTimedOutBody.description: Under 'Hidden after N seconds' on desktop's payment QR. The other device is a phone or another computer.

deskQrCannotShow: This file cannot be shown as a QR code.

@deskQrCannotShow.description: Shown in place of the QR on desktop when the transaction file could not be read or cut into QR parts.

deskQrAimPayment: Point the camera at the payment QR on the other device.

@deskQrAimPayment.description: Hint in desktop's scan dialog when scanning a sender's animated payment QR.

deskQrAimReply: Point the camera at the reply QR on the other device.

@deskQrAimReply.description: Hint in desktop's scan dialog when scanning the reply to this wallet's payment or invoice.

deskQrAimAny: Point the camera at the QR code of a payment, a reply, an invoice or a finished payment.

@deskQrAimAny.description: Hint in desktop's scan dialog opened from Transaction files, which takes any of these four kinds.

deskQrNotTx: That is not a payment QR code.

@deskQrNotTx.description: Shown in desktop's scan dialog when the code in view is not an animated QR Payment code at all.

@deskQrScannedName.description: Name of a result line in Transaction files on desktop for a transaction that came in by the camera, in place of a file name.

@deskQrPastedName.description: Name of a result line in Transaction files on desktop for a transaction pasted in the scan dialog, in place of a file name.

deskQrScanFinalize: Or scan their reply as a QR code.

@deskQrScanFinalize.description: Line beside Scan QR on desktop's Finalize step, under the box that takes the reply file.

deskSetTxQrHint: Pay and get paid by showing and scanning a transaction as an animated QR code, with no network needed. On this computer it comes with File Transfer: Show QR and Scan QR sit beside the file buttons.

@deskSetTxQrHint.description: Hint of the QR Payment method in desktop Settings › Payment methods.

deskQrScanImport: Or scan the payment or invoice as a QR code.

@deskQrScanImport.description: Line beside Scan QR on desktop's Sign a payment step, under the box that takes the sender's file or an invoice.
